name: Otome Game no Heroine ni Natta noni Shin'yuu ga Jamasugite Kouryaku ga Dekimasen!
original_name: 乙女ゲームのヒロインになったのに親友が邪魔すぎて攻略ができません！
source:
"The girl troubling with love... can you hear me? I'm the goddess of love... your wish has been granted...
This is the world of romance games... where a girl can tie with one of her love partners in the end...
And you... are the heroine of this world now..."

I'm Sato Aya. An ordinary high school girl who became the heroine of an otome game.
But why, why do I always end up with my best friend, no matter how I try !?
This is no good! I'm definitely going out with one of the three boys!

-- Ehhhhhhhh? The same thing happens, again???

[Translated from the [url=http://kagess.web.fc2.com/game/ohsk/index.html]official site[/url]]
